title: Facade Panelization & Quad Mesher
description: Subdivides double-curved architectural surfaces into planar quad panels with curvature analysis and fabrication edge bounds.
intendedOutcome: Generates fabrication-ready panelized curtain wall envelopes and unrolls panels for CNC cutting.
author: Computational Practice Lead
affectedData: Generates Rhino Breps, meshes, and coordinate tags.

title: Rhino ↔ Revit DirectShape Synchronizer
description: Streams complex Nurbs and Brep geometries directly into active Revit documents as categorized DirectShape elements (Mass / Generic Models / Curtain Panels).
intendedOutcome: Live synchronization between Rhino workspace and active Revit project via Rhino.Inside.Revit memory pipeline.
author: Digital Delivery Specialist
affectedData: Creates and commits DirectShape geometry elements in active Revit model.

title: Structural Spaceframe & Diagrid Generator
description: Computes parametric spatial diagrid node coordinates, beam vectors, and export centerlines for structural engineering coordination.
intendedOutcome: Generates analytical and physical structural framing wireframes and node payloads.
author: Structural Lead
affectedData: Creates centerlines and structural node points.

title: Rhino Model Hygiene & CAD Layer Purge
description: Audits Rhino document, removes unreferenced blocks, empty layers, duplicate curves, and fixes bad geometry tolerances.
intendedOutcome: Clean, optimized Rhino model file ready for coordination or export to Revit/Navisworks.
author: Model Coordinator
affectedData: Purges unused layers, annotations, and empty blocks.

title: Solar Radiation & Insolation Audit
description: Calculates cumulative solar radiation on building facade masses using Ladybug Tools weather EPW metrics.
intendedOutcome: Heatmap visual feedback and compliance export of solar exposure across building envelopes.
author: Sustainability Specialist
